text: AvtoVAZ, the maker of Lada cars, is owned by LADA Auto Holding; since 5 May 2023 NAMI, a federal state unitary enterprise under Russia's Ministry of Industry and Trade, is its sole owner.
short: AvtoVAZ (Lada) is wholly owned by state institute NAMI.

source.name: Interfax: «Ростех» вышел из капитала «АвтоВАЗа», 100% долей которого консолидировал НАМИ
source.note: English: 'EGRUL data shows that on 5 May NAMI became the sole owner of LADA Auto Holding LLC.' The same article states that LADA Auto Holding is AvtoVAZ's owner and calls NAMI a federal state unitary enterprise subordinate to the Ministry of Industry and Trade.
source.quote: Данные ЕГРЮЛ свидетельствуют, что 5 мая НАМИ стал единственным владельцем ООО «Лада Авто Холдинг».

additionalSources.name: TASS: French carmaker Renault's assets in Russia get nationalized, ministry announces
additionalSources.note: Covers the first step, Renault's 67.69% stake going to NAMI (a state-backed research center); Interfax documents the 2023 consolidation to 100%.
additionalSources.quote: NAMI, a state-backed research center, has become the owner of Renault's stake in Avtovaz
